column1: COMMANDER MAINBOARD rev A1 - ESTIMATED COST AND PART AVAILABILITY (US dollars)

Prepared 2026-11-13. A BUDGET, NOT A QUOTATION: prices and stock are snapshots found on distributor pages through web search, of unknown age; several contradict each other; prices above 100 pieces are mostly estimates. The board is not finished, so the parts list can still change.
Not included: shipping, import duties and taxes, tooling / engineering charges, the case, the keyboard, the battery module, yield losses.
Bare board (6 layers, 1.2 mm, ENIG, via-in-pad, impedance control)
How the three non-component lines were estimated

column2: The outline fits a 325 x 138 mm rectangle (0.045 m2) although the L shape itself is only about 0.011 m2; the price assumes the rectangle is paid for. Sharing the panel with the keyboard, as planned, lowers it. Low quantities are dominated by the set-up charge for a 6-layer impedance board.

About 640 parts and 3,000 solder joints on two sides. At 5 and 10 boards the cost is mostly set-up, two stencils and the per-part loading fee for parts outside the assembler's standard library (about 70 different ones).
Flashing the eMMC and a power-up / PoE / USB check. By hand at low quantity, on a fixture from 1,000.
